name: experimental_qwen35_matrix_norm_rope_token_tile16_v1
architecture: Explicit snapshotted candidate_tile16_i in existing default-off candidate; requires candidate_tensor_i. Same Revision8B-B Matrix512, same 1572864-byte SharedL2; no new arithmetic arrays or replacement top
arithmetic: Raw BF16 H1024 and checkpoint weights; ascending K0..1023 sequential FP32 FMA; terminal BF16-RNE; Norm2560xc1; partial64 all-products-BF16 RoPE0xb1. Q256gate remains raw
iteration: batch of min(16,remaining), ascending head, ascending32-column tile for Matrix; then ascending active row for Norm/RoPE; all stores ACK before batch/head staging reuse
activation_gather: Each source token one DMA1024x2bytes, srcstride2,dststride64,dstbase+2row. Preserve other byte lanes. Gather once perbatch; reuse across all heads
staging: Existing activation64KiB and weight64KiB. SharedL2 packed reserve fixed16*head_packed_bytes (Q16384,K8192), tile-major packed_base+tile*1024+row*64. Norm/RoPE each512bytes; gamma512; explicit trig128bytes/token. No whole-tensor cache
weights: One64KiB weight DMA per32column tile perbatch, shared by all active Matrix rows; retain complete56bit DDR weight-range preflight
stores: Packed per32column tile DMA64bytes x active_rows, localstride64, DDRstrideQ8192/K1024. Perrow Norm/RoPE each8x64byte DMA to token/head whole-tensor DDR bases. Terminal completed_heads perrow only after last ACK; completed_tokens counts fully completed batches, advancing active_rows only after lastrow of lasthead ACK
admission: 1<=count<=128;33bit token_start+count<=descriptorM<=128. Explicit mode requires tensor,head0. Seven local regions pairwise disjoint within actual1.5MiB, packed fixed16row reserve also for tails; allselected DDR windows pairwise disjoint. No address truncation before checks
failure: Every active Matrix output row must pass nonfinite check before any tile writes; inactive rows ignored. First fatal status terminates, acknowledged outputs not rolled back. Reset simultaneously flushes external fabric and owner. Samecycle and delayed ACK, held requests/sideband snapshots tested

frozen_gate.supplemental: Baseline tails1/3 and successful17-token K two-batch gate uses separate coldtoken16 K0/K1 realsource cases320/321; complete negatives,faults,reset and recovery inventories frozen in runner/tests

references: Every active K accumulator bitwise independent integer dyadic and separate C fmaf; eachhead and command native max_abs<=0.03125,mean_abs<=0.005 unchanged. Native failures preserved separately from RTL match
counters: For N tokens,B=ceil(N/16),H heads,T32column tiles: Matrix packets=B*H*T*1024; active observations=N*H*T*1024*32; readbytes=2048*N+65536*B*H*T; writebytes=N*H*(64*T+1024). All cycles from accepted command through final ACK/done remain in fixed512lane denominator; report candidate scope, never wholeblock90%
artifact_policy: Git/CI summaries only source,pins,hashes and small results; full source payloads,NPZ,memh,binary reference/trace,generatedRTL rebuilt transiently
